title: Capture measures Slot fit on every text and image slot; a picture's keep flag follows its measured kind
steps: S1: From the checkout run: node --test packages/cms/tracy-quickstart-tools/test/slot-fit.test.mjs packages/wo/website-opportunities/test/domain-content-map-fit.test.mjs scripts/test/slot-roles-contract-check.test.mjs
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the tests named below.
expect: A class photo marked customize keep loses the flag and gets kind photo, its boxes per viewport and aspect.
An icon, an avatar strip and a transparent hero cut-out are kept; the cut-out says transparent true.
The contract check refuses a kept photo and a slot without fit in a map that declares Slot fit.
evidence: A Joomla boxing template's contract kept 198 of 257 picture slots, so a site built from a brief kept mostly demo photos, and no slot said its box or that the hero needs a transparent picture.
fence: measureSlotFit turns the coverage audit's measured boxes and file transparency into fit, and sets customize keep from the kind; checkContentMapFit refuses a flag that disagrees with the kind.

tests: a class photo the old rule kept becomes replaceable, with the box of each viewport and its shape
icons, faces and cut-outs are kept, and the hero cut-out says it needs a transparent picture
the keep flag of a picture follows its kind: a kept photo and a replaceable icon are both errors
a broken Slot fit fails the contract check: a kept photo, a missing fit
